snippet.description:

snippet.title: Mosaico Turns Prompts Into Physical Apps
snippet.description:
ESP-Mosaico is a $59 modular development kit designed around AI coding agents.

snippet.title: Anthropic Gave Claude Its Own Computer — How Claude Duet Works
snippet.description:
Anthropic’s new Claude Duet is more than another Claude model update. It’s a proactive AI agent with its own cloud computer and browser, meaning you can give it work, close your laptop, and let it continue in the background.

In this video, we look at what Claude Duet actually does, how its cloud computer works, its morning brief, the 6,000+ connectors and plugins Anthropic says it can access, the kinds of jobs it can handle across apps like Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, HubSpot and Shopify, and where it still needs your approval.

We also cover the important limitations: Claude Duet is still a research preview, it doesn’t monitor everything continuously, background work counts against your Claude usage limits, its browser can’t currently be watched or taken over, and some actions remain completely off-limits.

Claude Duet is currently available through a waitlist for eligible Claude Pro and Max users in the United States.

snippet.title: How Noise-Cancelling Headphones Actually Cancel Sound
snippet.description:
How do noise-cancelling headphones actually make the world quieter - by creating MORE sound?

In this video, we break down how Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) actually works: how microphones listen to the noise around you, how your headphones generate a carefully timed opposing sound, and how destructive interference reduces the noise that reaches your ears.
We also look at why ANC works so well against airplane engines, trains and fans, but struggles more with voices and sudden sounds - plus the difference between passive isolation, feedforward ANC, feedback ANC and hybrid systems.

Noise cancellation isn't really creating silence.
It's fighting sound with sound.

ChatGPT can now build interactive tools, games, visual explanations and mini apps directly inside your conversation - and you don't need to write any code.

In this video, I test GPT-6's new Intelligent UI by asking ChatGPT to build five completely different experiences: a bill splitter, an interactive four-stroke engine, a retro game, a ridiculous “Should I Buy It?” decision machine, and a mini heart-learning app with its own quiz.

The trick is surprisingly simple: describe what you want ChatGPT to build, then tell it what you want to be able to do with it.

snippet.description:

There’s just one problem: there are basically no consumer Wi-Fi 8 phones or laptops to connect to it yet, and the Wi-Fi 8 standard isn’t even finalized.
So why does a Wi-Fi 8 router already exist?

snippet.title: Bose Just Made Wired Earbuds Cool Again?
snippet.description:
Bose just brought wired earbuds back. 

The new Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds connect over USB-C and combine active noise cancellation with lossless audio support, low-latency wired listening, and something wireless earbuds can't offer: no Bluetooth pairing, no charging case, and no internal battery to recharge.

They cost $99 — and they're Bose's first new wired earbuds in more than a decade.

snippet.description:

The new Kindles come in colors including Ube, Alpine Sky, Seaglass Green and Fig, alongside redesigned hardware, a flush-front display on the standard Kindle, thinner and lighter designs, and what Amazon says is roughly 30% faster performance on the new standard model.
